name: Nyx Native Gesture Suppressor
description: Companion to the nyx-gestures daemon backend: disables BOTH GNOME native swipe trackers (workspaceAnimation horizontal + overview vertical) so they cannot double-fire alongside the daemon's injected actions. Without it, 3-finger horizontal also switches workspace and 4-finger up also shows a workspace preview. Handles no gestures itself, injects no keys, and restores both trackers on disable.
